findings.issue: 何も is read なにも in standard Japanese; なんも is a nonstandard/colloquial variant inappropriate for an N5 course sentence with no dialect context.
Reading of 何 in 何も is なに (standard なにも), not なん; なん appears before counters/copula (何で, 何と), not in 何も+negative.
Romaji carries the same wrong reading nanmo; standard reading is nanimo.
ほしい glossed as "dear/priced" — that is not a meaning of 欲しい in any sense; the literal meaning is "wanted/desired". Teaches a false word meaning in the literal mirror.
その glossed "far from the speaker" describes あの; その is near-the-listener/anaphoric (here anaphoric). Contradicts the correct その gloss used in sent:tatoeba-157761.
Parêntese "(longe do falante)" descreve あの, não その (série そ = perto do ouvinte / já mencionado; aqui uso anafórico). Inconsistente com o gloss correto em tatoeba-157761.
findings.suggested: esse, essa (perto do ouvinte / já mencionado)

findings.issue: 久しぶりに is a temporal adverbial ("after a long interval"), not manner; the structural label "(manner)" is the wrong grammatical category.
findings.current: I (topic) after a long time (manner) visited that city (object).
findings.suggested: I (topic) after a long time (time) visited that city (object).

findings.issue: 久しぶりに é adverbial de tempo, não de modo; o rótulo estrutural "(modo)" está na categoria gramatical errada.
"querido" lê-se primariamente como "dear/amado", não como particípio "desejado"; gloss literal ambíguo para ほしい (deve espelhar "desejado/querido (que se quer)").
Missing space before the parenthesis in the pt gloss.
